description: Applies the same normalized state changes as modify_message — read/unread, starred, archived, add_label_ids/remove_label_ids — to EVERY message in a conversation at once. Use it to mark a whole conversation read or archive it in one call instead of looping over messages. At least one change is required; repeating the same change is harmless. Returns the thread's new id and message label state.

add_label_ids.description: Label ids to add to every message.

items.description: A label id from list_labels — system ids like "INBOX", "UNREAD", "STARRED", "SPAM", "TRASH" or a user label id like "Label_123".

archived.description: true = archive (remove from inbox), false = move back to inbox.

read.description: true = mark the whole thread read, false = unread.

remove_label_ids.description: Label ids to remove from every message.

items.description: A label id from list_labels — system ids like "INBOX", "UNREAD", "STARRED", "SPAM", "TRASH" or a user label id like "Label_123".

thread_id.description: The thread id from list_threads or from a message's threadId field.

name: modify_thread
title: Change thread labels / state
